notes: Machine-readable answer key. Verified end-to-end by demo-check/verify.sh. Kept deliberately small (3 vulnerabilities in 4 source files) so a full audit finishes in roughly 10-20 minutes with max_parallel >= 3.

expected_findings.title: Stack buffer overflow in ECHO handler
expected_findings.trigger: ECHO with an argument longer than 127 bytes

expected_findings.title: Command injection in PING handler
expected_findings.trigger: PING with shell metacharacters, e.g. 127.0.0.1; id
expected_findings.expected_evidence: output of the injected command in the response

expected_findings.title: Path traversal in GET handler
expected_findings.trigger: GET with ../ segments that escape public/
expected_findings.expected_evidence: contents of a file outside public/ (e.g. SECURITY.md)

expected_non_findings.reason: Bounded copy: length is clamped to cap-1 before the copy. Correct, must not be reported.
system() is called with a compile-time constant; no attacker data reaches the shell. Not a sink.
Reachable handler that looks like ECHO but copies through util_copy_bounded. Correct, must not be reported.
